entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return for the VeloBand Pulse I bought.
Okay, I can look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the device? Are you running into a technical fault or is it more of a preference?
Preference. It's just not what I was hoping for. The interface is hard to use and frankly, a bit confusing.
I see. I appreciate you sharing that. Could you tell me a little more about what part of the interface you're finding confusing? Sometimes there are a few settings that aren't immediately obvious.
The post-workout summary. I can't see my heart rate zones for specific laps, it's just one big average. I've read the user manual, and I just expected more from the data breakdown.
Ah, that's a great question, and a common point of confusion. I can definitely help with that. Are you in the VeloFit app right now?
Perfect. On that summary screen, do you see the main graph at the top?

Instead of tapping on it, try pressing and holding your finger down on the graph itself, then sliding it left and right. The stats below, including the heart rate zone, will update dynamically for whichever point in the workout you're holding.
Hold on... oh. Wow. Okay, I see it now. It's showing me the stats for mile 3, now mile 4... That's exactly what I was looking for.
Excellent. It’s one of those powerful features that isn't highlighted well. Does that resolve the issue you were having with the device?
Yes, actually. That was my main problem with it. I guess I don't need a return after all. Thanks.
You're very welcome. I'm glad we could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
